title: When Your Reviewer is an LLM: Biases, Divergence, and Prompt Injection Risks in Peer Review

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing LLM-assigned review scores to human reviewer baselines across different paper quality tiers to measure systematic rating inflation, particularly for lower-quality submissions.

Using bottom-up topic modeling (BERTopic) and textual-level analysis to compare the thematic emphasis of LLMs (e.g., favoring technical implementation and empirical rigor) against human reviewers (e.g., favoring novelty and clarity).

Analyzing the alignment between LLM and human ratings across different research tracks (e.g., General Machine Learning vs. Social Aspects of Machine Learning) to measure domain-specific evaluation discrepancies.
